prompt: Blue brings home the biggest toy box on the street
title: Biggest Toy Box
hook: Biggest toy box on the street!
irony: Blue hauls home the biggest toy box to keep toys inside, but the toys spill out while the kids pile in, so Blue climbs in too and becomes the best surprise.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Blue wheels a giant toy box down the street as Green and Navy stare up at it.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green clutches his dinosaur book and names toy box facts while Blue offers surprises to everyone.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: The giant toy box sticks in the big house doorway and Black dares the kids to empty it.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Everyone circles the giant toy box on the street, chanting about the biggest toy box.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Jade dives inside to push while scared Green reads warnings and the toys spill everywhere.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Navy gives away armfuls of toys to Black while Jade and Green tumble headfirst into the empty toy box.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The crowd circles the giant toy box again, chanting the same happy chant.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Blue sits on the curb with Gray and Navy, sadly watching the scattered toys.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Blue decides the kids beat the toys and squeezes into the empty toy box herself.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Blue pops up inside the toy box as the kids cheer the turned happy chant.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Blue shares the giant toy box as a street clubhouse while Green and Navy climb in beside her.
